items.title: Shared formatRelativeTime helper
items.precondition: Execution complete; frontend lib file present
steps: Confirm Intl.RelativeTimeFormat (or equivalent native) buckets match the spec table
items.expected: Single shared helper with no new npm dependencies.
items.evidence: 2026-07-28: Human verified (user declined -tw after checking results). Helper present at frontend/src/lib/formatRelativeTime.ts; smoke: just now / N minutes|hours|days ago; no new deps.
items.notes: Isolated accept runtime was started then stopped; UI acceptance deferred to human check.

items.title: Feed post relative timestamps
items.precondition: Signed-in app with at least one post
steps: Confirm each post header shows a right-aligned relative time (e.g. minutes/hours/days ago), not a full locale datetime as primary text
Hover the time and confirm absolute title
items.expected: Feed uses formatRelativeTime; layout remains name left / time right.
items.evidence: 2026-07-28: Human verified by user — feed relative timestamps checked in running app; -tw browser pass skipped per user.

items.title: Comment and reply relative timestamps
items.precondition: Post detail with a parent comment and at least one reply
steps: Open a post with threaded comments
Confirm top-level comment author row shows right-aligned relative time
Confirm each reply shows right-aligned relative time
Confirm Reply button and inline reply composer still work
items.expected: Parents and replies show relative times right-aligned; composer/Reply behavior unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-07-28: Human verified by user — comment and reply timestamps checked; -tw browser pass skipped per user.

items.title: No live ticking / no API change
steps: Confirm no setInterval for relative labels
Confirm no migration or backend changes in the execution diff
items.expected: Display-only frontend change; labels update only on re-render/reload.
items.evidence: 2026-07-28: Diff is frontend-only (formatRelativeTime.ts, FeedPage, PostDetailPage, plans). No setInterval; no migration/API changes.
